request.notes: Replaces r5-slots-002 (infra_error: the H200 offer listed $5.55/h but the pod bills $6.69/h, which the $5.00 cap could not cover for max_hours + 0.25 h; no pod became ready). Cap $6.20 covers $6.69/h x 0.9 h. The code is pinned by ref (a commit on the branch that holds this request): the pilot of r5-slots-002 plus an optional dead-direction term in the closure loss (config sam_set_dg) and an explicit config order. Study budget $25: r5-slots-002 $0.50 conservative, this pilot at most $6.20, the full job at most $18.30. Checks GPU memory, step time, training stability and the whole pipeline (float64 simulation with the tracker re-run for label maps, float32 slot encoders trained 4 replicas at once by truncated BPTT with persistent slot memory, CPU certification workers) at reduced size. Device data are passed to jitted functions as arguments; compiled functions are released between configs. No network or subprocess use outside setup. Training stops starting configs 19 min after job start, certification 26 min. CPU test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size from a git archive of exactly these paths at the pinned commit's content.
request.purpose: Round-5 study slots (track 1), pilot: slot encoders with memory on raw gliders level 0 (soft k-means, learned geometric slot attention; closure with and without the dead-direction term, reconstruction, supervised capacity control), reduced size: 48 trajectories per half, 600 steps, 6 configs
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
